name: std-calendar-sync
description: std-calendar-sync — two-way Google Calendar synchronization engine. PUSH: a 15-minute cron scan (and the user-addressable SYNC_NOW) walks `targetEntity` rows whose `externalEventId` marker is blank and creates a remote event per row through calendar.createEvent, reading the summary/start/end via the configured field mapping (`titleField`/`startField`/`endField`/`durationMinutes` fallback/`locationField`/`descriptionField`) — so ANY event-shaped host entity pushes, provided it declares the two marker columns `externalEventId : string` and `syncedAt : number` (the remindedAt precedent). PULL: `CAL_REMOTE_CHANGED` (delivered by the shared /api/hooks/google-calendar ingress from a calendar.watch channel) or the same cycle after a clean push lists remote events (incremental via the in-memory sync token; a restart falls back to a full window list) and upserts each into the atom's own canonical `CalendarEvent` store, matched by `externalEventId` — pulls land in the canonical store, NOT the arbitrary target, because persist keys are static in the language; bind calendar UI to `CalendarEvent` to surface remote events. Conflict detection (local-newer-than-remote) needs a local-modified marker convention and is a recorded gap, not a decorative state. Composes with std-notify-on-event via CAL_SYNCED / CAL_SYNC_FAILED.

fields.description: ISO start (dateTime, or YYYY-MM-DD for all-day).
fields.name: startsAt

fields.description: ISO end (dateTime, or YYYY-MM-DD for all-day).
fields.name: endsAt

fields.description: Google Calendar event id this row mirrors; the pull-upsert match key.
fields.name: externalEventId
fields.synonyms: remote id, google id, calendar event id

fields.description: When this row last synced with the remote calendar; 0 = never.
fields.name: syncedAt

fields.description: Scratch: Google incremental-sync token from the last listEvents; in-memory per instance — a restart falls back to a full list.
fields.name: syncToken

fields.description: When the last full push+pull cycle completed; 0 = never.
fields.name: lastSyncedAt

fields.description: Scratch: id of the target row the push loop is currently exporting.
fields.name: headId

fields.description: Scratch: remote events remaining in the current pull-upsert loop.
fields.name: pending

fields.description: Last sync failure detail; blank = none.
fields.name: lastError

calendarId.description: Google calendar to sync with; blank = the service's default (GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ID env, else primary).
calendarId.label: Calendar id

descriptionField.description: Target-entity field holding the description/notes; blank = none.
descriptionField.label: Description field

durationField.description: Target-entity field holding the per-row duration in minutes (e.g. ClassSession.durationMinutes). Takes precedence over the fixed `durationMinutes` when set; ignored when `endField` is set. Field precedence: endField > durationField > durationMinutes — the corpus carries all these event shapes.
durationField.label: Duration field
durationField.synonyms: minutes field, length field, per-row duration

durationMinutes.description: Fixed event length used when both `endField` and `durationField` are blank; the calendar service computes the timezone-correct end.
durationMinutes.label: Duration (minutes)

enabled.description: Push local records to Google Calendar and pull remote events into the CalendarEvent store. Off by default; needs the calendar service credentials (GOOGLE_CALENDAR_SA_KEY).
enabled.label: Sync with Google Calendar
enabled.synonyms: enable, calendar sync, google calendar, two-way sync, sync events, connect calendar

endField.description: Target-entity field holding the ISO end. Blank = derive the end from `durationMinutes` instead (the corpus carries all four event shapes).
endField.label: End field

locationField.description: Target-entity field holding the location; blank = none.
locationField.label: Location field

startField.description: Target-entity field holding the ISO start (dateTime, or YYYY-MM-DD for all-day).
startField.label: Start field
startField.synonyms: start date field, begins field, scheduledAt field

targetEntity.description: Event-shaped entity whose rows export to Google Calendar. MUST declare the marker columns `externalEventId : string = ""` and `syncedAt : number = 0` (stamped by the push loop). Defaults to the atom's own CalendarEvent store so the standalone validates; rebind per composition.
targetEntity.label: Entity to push
targetEntity.synonyms: entity to sync, source entity, record type, appointments entity, sessions entity

titleField.description: Target-entity field holding the event title.
titleField.label: Title field

emits.description: A full push+pull cycle completed; wire to std-notify-on-event or a status surface.
A calendar service call / fetch / persist failed — lastError carries the detail and the cycle stops until the next trigger.
Target rows with a blank externalEventId marker — the remaining local→remote export queue.
calendar.createEvent result, flattened onto the payload by the call-service effect executor.
Target row stamped with its new externalEventId; drives the next push pass.
calendar.listEvents result — the remote change set for the pull-upsert loop.
CalendarEvent rows loaded for externalEventId matching in the pull-upsert.
One remote event upserted into the CalendarEvent store; drives the next pull pass.
Pull loop control: how many remote events remain in the queue.
